fullContentHtml:
Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Result - Overview

Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (BRABU), Muzaffarpur has declared the Bihar B.Ed Combined Entrance Test (CET-BED) 2026 result on 19 June 2026. The entrance exam was conducted on 7 June 2026 in CBT mode across multiple exam centers in Bihar. Candidates can download their Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 scorecard from the official portal biharcetbed-brabu.in using their application number and password.

Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Qualifying Marks

  • General Category: Minimum 35% (42 marks out of 120)
  • OBC / EBC / EWS: Minimum 30% (36 marks out of 120)
  • SC / ST: Minimum 30% (36 marks out of 120)
  • PwD (Divyaang): Minimum 30% (36 marks out of 120)

Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Expected Cutoff

  • General (UR): 75-85 marks out of 120
  • OBC: 60-70 marks out of 120
  • EBC: 60-70 marks out of 120
  • EWS: 60-70 marks out of 120
  • SC: 50-60 marks out of 120
  • ST: 50-60 marks out of 120
  • PwD (Divyaang): 36-50 marks out of 120
  • Female Candidates: 40-50 marks out of 120

Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Toppers List

  • Himanshu Ajnabi (Vaishali) - 117 marks - Rank 1
  • Vivek Kumar (Kathiar) - 117 marks - Rank 1
  • Anjanu Kumari (Sitamarhi) - 116 marks - Top Female
  • Priyanka Paswan (Begusarai) - 116 marks
  • Ramdev Kumar (Madhubani) - 104 marks

How to Download Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Result

  1. Visit the official website: biharcetbed-brabu.in
  2. Click on the 'Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Result' link on the homepage
  3. Enter your Application Number and Password (Date of Birth)
  4. Click on 'Submit' to view your scorecard
  5. Download and take a printout of the Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 scorecard for future reference

Details Mentioned on Bihar B.Ed Scorecard 2026

  • Candidate Name and Application Number
  • Roll Number
  • Marks Obtained (out of 120)
  • Overall Rank in Merit List
  • Category (General / OBC / SC / ST / EWS)
  • Qualifying Status (Qualified / Not Qualified)
  • Course Applied (Regular B.Ed / Shiksha Shastri)

Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Counselling Process

Bihar B.Ed counselling 2026 begins from 20 June 2026. Qualified candidates must follow these steps:

  1. Counselling Registration: Register online on biharcetbed-brabu.in with application number and basic details
  2. Choice Filling: Select minimum 3 and maximum 10 preferred B.Ed colleges and universities
  3. Seat Allotment: Seats allotted based on merit rank, category, and college preferences
  4. Document Verification: Report to allotted college with original documents for verification
  5. Final Admission: Pay admission fee and confirm seat

Documents Required for Bihar B.Ed Counselling 2026

  • Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Scorecard
  • Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Admit Card
  • 10th and 12th Mark Sheets and Certificates
  • Graduation Mark Sheets and Degree Certificate (for B.Ed)
  • Caste Certificate (if applicable)
  • EWS Certificate (if applicable)
  • PwD Certificate (if applicable)
  • Residence / Domicile Certificate
  • Passport Size Photographs
  • Photo ID Proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, etc.)

Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 - Participating Universities

  • Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (BRABU), Muzaffarpur (Nodal University)
  • Lalit Narayan Mithila University (LNMU), Darbhanga
  • Patna University, Patna
  • Magadh University, Bodh Gaya
  • Bhupendra Narayan Mandal University (BNMU), Madhepura
  • Jai Prakash University, Chapra
  • Munger University, Munger
  • Purnea University, Purnea
  • Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University, Bhagalpur
  • Patliputra University, Patna
  • Veer Kunwar Singh University, Ara
  • Aryabhatt Knowledge University, Patna
  • Kameshwar Singh Darbhanga Sanskrit University, Darbhanga
  • Maulana Mazharul Haque Arabic and Persian University, Patna

Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 Exam Pattern

  • Exam Mode: Computer Based Test (CBT)
  • Total Questions: 120
  • Total Marks: 120
  • Marking Scheme: +1 for correct answer, No negative marking
  • Duration: 2 Hours
  • Subjects: General Awareness, Teaching Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, Language Proficiency

When was Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 result declared?

The Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 result was declared on 19 June 2026 by BRABU, Muzaffarpur.

How to check Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 result?

Visit biharcetbed-brabu.in, click on result link, enter application number and password to download scorecard.

What is the official website for Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 result?

The official website is biharcetbed-brabu.in.

What are the qualifying marks for Bihar B.Ed CET 2026?

General category needs minimum 42 marks (35%), reserved categories need minimum 36 marks (30%) out of 120.

When does Bihar B.Ed counselling 2026 start?

Bihar B.Ed counselling 2026 begins from 20 June 2026. Candidates must register online for choice filling and seat allotment.

What is the Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 cutoff for General category?

The expected cutoff for General category is 75-85 marks out of 120.

How many candidates qualified in Bihar B.Ed CET 2026?

Over 90% of candidates who appeared in the exam have qualified.

What details are on Bihar B.Ed CET 2026 scorecard?

The scorecard includes candidate name, roll number, marks obtained (out of 120), rank, category, and qualifying status.

Which universities participate in Bihar B.Ed CET 2026?

14 universities participate including BRABU, LNMU, Patna University, Magadh University, BNMU and more.
